releases.title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.27
releases.summary: The Installer now updates with the build, keeping your complete setup.

sections.heading: One BlackLanturn update
bullets: The Installer, included add-ons and tested BlackLanturn patches update together.
Once Build 1.1.27 and Installer 1.0.32 are installed, future build updates no longer require a separate Installer update through the repository.

sections.heading: Protected update and recovery
bullets: Updates are staged and checked before replacing code. Interrupted Installer updates can recover when BlackLanturn starts.
Close and reopen Kodi after updating to load the complete new version.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: Your playback settings, authorizations, watched progress, sources, favourites and other saved data stay in place.
Other add-ons you installed stay untouched; platform playback fixes remain included.

releases.title: BlackLanturn 1.1.28
releases.summary: Direct update access, clearer completion and easier genre navigation.

sections.heading: Easier updates
bullets: Update from a BlackLanturn notification opens your installed build update confirmation directly.
After a successful update, Close Kodi is selected. Close later remains available; reopen Kodi after closing.
Older BlackLanturn update prompts also use the in-place updater.

sections.heading: Genre navigation
bullets: Choose genre now follows Details in main Movies and Shows Options.
Genre choices stay hidden while browsing episodes and seasons.

sections.heading: Consistent Details artwork and previews
bullets: Details artwork and previews now use the same compact hero area and soft edge fades as other previews.
An unavailable update catalog shows a retry message and leaves your setup unchanged.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: Included add-ons, Installer and tested patches update together through Update BlackLanturn.
Settings, accounts, playback preferences, sources, watched progress and unrelated add-ons remain in place.

sections.heading: Easier navigation

Returning from another page keeps your place. Opening Updates adds no network requests.

releases.title: BlackLanturn 1.1.30
releases.summary: Update-safe personal extensions and faster, bounded row loading.

sections.heading: Keep your personal setup
bullets: Installed personal pages and icon packs use external registrations, so managed code can update and verify without removing them.
Accounts, authorizations, source choices, watched progress, favourites and unrelated add-ons remain saved.

sections.heading: Faster browsing
bullets: YouTube reuses content preferences within each owned request while keeping account checks and watched status current.
Visible rows take priority, obsolete queued work is replaced, and disposable row writes are batched.

sections.heading: Clear menus and reliable updates
bullets: Choose genre remains available after Details in Movies and Shows browsing and is omitted inside seasons and episodes.
Compatible installations can use smaller component downloads with the same verification and rollback protections.

releases.summary: Sculpted Silver and Smoked Glass icon packs are now included in both builds.

sections.heading: Branded icons included
bullets: Both public editions include the complete Sculpted Silver and Smoked Glass packs, with 90 icons in each.
New installations use Sculpted Silver. Choose Smoked Glass or Original in the icon pack selector.

sections.heading: Keep your choice and your setup

The icon resource is included in full installations and smaller supported updates. Personal Fight Zone setup remains private.

releases.title: BlackLanturn 1.1.32
releases.summary: Lower update memory use, safer recovery and faster return to lower browsing rows.

sections.heading: Lighter, protected updates
bullets: Update files are processed in small chunks, reducing memory pressure on Fire Stick.
Kodi pauses new background row requests and automatic previews while updating. Keep Kodi open until the update finishes.
An interrupted update recovers the previous complete add-ons and patches before retrying.

sections.heading: Faster lower-row browsing
bullets: More small rows can be reused within the same cache byte limit, reducing repeated loading as you browse deeper.
Recommendation freshness and watched-status refreshes remain active.

sections.heading: Your complete setup stays saved
bullets: Update BlackLanturn keeps your accounts, settings, sources, favourites, watched progress and other installed add-ons.
Both approved icon packs remain included. Personal Fight Zone remains outside the public packages.

releases.title: BlackLanturn 1.1.33
releases.summary: Consistent landscape browsing cards and reversible title recommendations.

sections.heading: Consistent landscape cards
bullets: Title, season and episode cards keep a landscape frame as you browse and move to the next page.
Available wide artwork is preferred. Poster-only fallbacks stay centered without stretching; season and episode labels stay readable.

sections.heading: Control titles in discovery
bullets: Hide an exact movie or show, or choose Show less without reducing an entire genre.
Undo immediately, or restore titles from Settings → Recommendations. Search, My Stuff and watched progress remain accessible.

sections.heading: Your setup stays saved
bullets: Use Update BlackLanturn to retain settings, accounts, sources, authorizations, progress and other installed add-ons.
Both branded icon packs remain included. Personal Fight Zone stays outside public packages.

sections.heading: Tracking setup completes automatically
bullets: New bundled modules are registered and enabled before the update reports success.
Corrects the disabled Helper Trakt/MDbList modules introduced in1.1.34. Saved tracking choices and authorizations stay in place.

sections.heading: Preservation and recovery
bullets: Existing disabled user add-ons remain untouched. Later explicit provider disables remain saved.
Registration failures restore the previous code, release details and prior module enabled states; interrupted registration is recoverable.
